assist.exactQuestion: Acquire materially new primary or independent evidence reusable by the root owner to close source-addressed underwriting gaps.

claims.claim: FDA approved Regeneron's OTARMENI (lunsotogene parvec-cwha) on April 23, 2026 for specified pediatric and adult patients with OTOF-associated severe-to-profound/profound sensorineural hearing loss; FDA identifies Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as manufacturer and STN 125874.
claims.materiality: Adds a materially independent regulator-origin source confirming a 2026 commercial/regulatory execution outcome outside the SEC/issuer/market-data origins already used by Alpha.

claims.claim: FDA described OTARMENI as the first-ever dual-AAV vector gene therapy approved for OTOF-associated hearing loss and stated accelerated approval may depend on verification of durability and clinical benefit, preserving a concrete post-approval execution obligation rather than treating approval as certainty of durable value.
claims.materiality: Supports platform breadth while explicitly bounding durability uncertainty for Alpha's confidence assessment.

risks.risk: Accelerated approval carries continuing evidence obligations; durability and downstream clinical benefit remain execution risks.

unknowns: This regulator evidence does not establish current valuation, supplier redundancy, or probability-adjusted value of other pipeline assets.
Scout does not assign numeric factor, risk, or confidence values.
recommendedNextState: Use the independent FDA regulator origin to strengthen source-addressed data-confidence and execution evidence while preserving accelerated-approval durability uncertainty.

learning.failedStrategy: Issuer/SEC/market-data lineage already covered operating, governance and valuation inputs but left confidence dependent on a narrow origin set.
learning.changedStrategy: Changed source class to independent federal regulator evidence confirming a material 2026 product approval and its continuing evidence obligation.
learning.nextLawfulAction: Alpha should re-evaluate data-confidence evidence using the new regulator origin; no Scout numeric underwriting.
